decisions.reason: Integrating videos with gallery pictures does not change the representative imagery required for services on the Services page.
The source changes video placement and gallery categorization, not the hover-animation behavior.
Adding videos alongside pictures does not replace or otherwise change the requirement that gallery photographs come from the client's portfolio.
The gallery's interactive scrolling behavior remains required unchanged; the source only determines where videos are displayed.
The source decision has no effect on the one-time pricing model or pricing tabs.
Video placement in the gallery does not change individual-service pricing, selection, or transparency.
Placing videos beside pictures does not cancel or modify the existing image-focused presentation requirement.
The requested homepage video location does not alter the destinations or behavior of homepage navigation buttons.
Locating videos beside portfolio photos does not change the requirement for portfolio tiles to link to the gallery.
The gallery video decision has no effect on mobile pricing-table interaction.
Placing videos beside homepage portfolio photos does not change the hero image, overlay, or image-emphasis settings.
The candidate already has a complete message-93 MODIFY recording that gallery videos are integrated with the pictures; no additional update, removal, or scope change is required.
